problemSignature.badState: fixture runner only wrote a report
problemSignature.requiredState: fixture runner creates concrete KiCad project artifacts and honest validation status

rootCause: A report-only fixture runner looked like progress but did not create a board that BoardForge could route, validate, or learn from.
fixSummary: Upgrade fixtures:run to create the odd-shape project folder, .kicad_pro, .kicad_sch, .kicad_pcb, routeability report, project manifest, and final status file while blocking manufacturing until real validation/routing runs.

testsAdded: fixture runner creates odd-shape preroute KiCad artifacts without fake manufacturing

recipe: Create fixture files in safe synthetic root only.
Write KiCad project, schematic, PCB, routeability report, and manifest.
Set validation to pending/null when KiCad CLI is unavailable.
Block manufacturing ZIP until DRC/ERC/routing evidence is clean.
safetyRules: do not touch protected ESC/FC paths
do not export manufacturing if validation has not run
